# GitHub Social Preview Image

## Recommended Image Specifications
- **Dimensions**: 1280x640 pixels (2:1 aspect ratio)
- **Format**: PNG or JPG
- **Size**: Under 1MB
- **Style**: Clean, professional, game-development themed

## Design Suggestions

### Color Scheme
- Background: Dark blue/black (#0d1117 to match GitHub dark theme)
- Accent colors: PICO-8 inspired (yellows, blues, pixel art colors)
- Text: White/light gray for contrast

### Content Elements
1. **Title**: "PICO-8 Test Driver" (large, bold)
2. **Tagline**: "Automated Testing Framework" (smaller)
3. **Visual Elements**:
   - Pixel art game character or test tube icon
   - PICO-8 cartridge graphic
   - Code snippets or test results
   - PICO-8 logo/colors

### Example Layout
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                         │
│  [Pixel Art Icon]  PICO-8 Test Driver                   │
│                                                         │
│                 Automated Testing Framework             │
│                                                         │
│  • Run tests programmatically                           │
│  • Debug game behavior                                  │
│  • Command-line integration                             │
│                                                         │
│  [Code Example or Test Results]                         │
│                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Tools for Creating
- **Canva**: Easy drag-and-drop design
- **Figma**: Professional design tool
- **GIMP/Photoshop**: Advanced editing
- **Online generators**: Use "GitHub social preview generator"

## File Naming
Save as: `social-preview.png` or `og-image.png`

## Upload Location
GitHub Settings > General > Social preview
